warnings: Mark-to-orientation pattern on this sheet: B1 = horizontal (x-direction) beams; B2 = vertical (y-direction) beams on the two PERIMETER column lines (grid 1 and grid 4); B3 = vertical (y-direction) beams on the two INTERIOR column lines (grid 2 and grid 3, framing the stairwell void S1). ⚠️ AMENDED 2026-08-24 — this is a tendency, not a rule, and it must not be used to infer a mark that was not read directly. Two confirmed exceptions, both horizontal beams printed as B2: the B2(+0.40) on dummy row B' between grids 2-3, and the B2(+2.10) stair-landing beam on row C between grids 2-3. หน้า16 already carried the same caveat for the upper floor. Levels in parentheses on the plan are each beam's own printed top level in metres relative to the house datum (ระดับดินเดิม, ±0.000) — recorded here as level_m on each element.

CORRECTED 2026-08-24 — row B. The earlier warning here had the bays exactly backwards: it claimed grid1-2 and grid3-4 print no beam at row B while grid2-3 carries a clear B1(+0.40). Per-bay coverage sweeps say the opposite. grid1-2: only the dash-dot grid line at row B (single line, coverage 0.797), no beam. grid2-3: also only the dash-dot line (0.781) — the beam that was recorded at this position actually sits on dummy row B' (3.55), its faces at y=1154-1158 / 1174-1180 px, and its printed mark reads B2, not B1 (read at 9x zoom). grid3-4: a real beam IS present at row B, faces at y=1105-1111 / 1127-1132 px, label read directly as B1(+0.40) — it was missing from the extraction and has been added as B1 B3-B4 span 3.00.

CORRECTED 2026-08-24 (Makham, y-axis dummy rows — see grid master warnings). Two changes on this sheet. (1) The beam previously recorded as 'B1 A2-A3 (+0.40)' does not exist: a pixel scan of the grid2-grid3 band at row A (y=805 px) finds only the thin dash-dot grid line (c≈135), not a beam double-line, whereas the same row in grid1-2 and grid3-4 shows clear beam face pairs at y=793/814 and y=791/812. The bay's two real beams sit on the new dummy rows A' (-1.10, faces at y=686/707) and A'' (+0.80, faces at y=886/907) — the entrance/stair projection that straddles row A. Both are now recorded separately. (2) The west appendage's split beam moved from the old A'=1.60 to A'''=2.00 (its faces measure y=994/1015, the tick on the south face).

West/north appendage (carport + kitchen slab, S0 markers, level +0.10~+0.45) sits in the grid1-grid2 x row A-A''' zone, outside the main house footprint per architecture (หน้า03). Its interior split beam B1(+0.35) lands on dummy row A''' (pos_m=2.00, see grid master). The appendage's perimeter (grid1 vertical A-B) is confirmed as B2(+0.35); no further beam label could be read for grid1 south of row B in this appendage zone despite 2x-2.2x zooming, so nothing is recorded south of B1 on grid1 — left blank rather than guessed.

A small unlabelled marker 'B0 (+0.10)' sits just west of grid1 at row C (a small square with an X, drawn like a floor opening/drain symbol rather than a column or footing box) — no legend on this sheet or elsewhere in the set defines it. Recorded as a low-confidence slab/opening marker, not as a footing or column (the footing plan หน้า14 shows no footing at this position).

CORRECTED 2026-08-24 — the 'south recessed room' is NOT off-grid and NOT at grid 1-2. It occupies grid3-grid4 x row C-row D exactly, landing on named grid lines on all four sides, and the earlier warning here (claiming it had no matching footing and no printed dimension for its south projection) was wrong on both counts: หน้า14's footing plan carries F1A footings at D3 and D4 — precisely this room's two south corners — and row D is a named grid with a printed 2.00 m C-D dimension. Measured evidence: row D beam faces at y=1640/1661 px in the grid3-4 bay; the two side beams trace continuously from row C to row D (grid 3 at x=1605, y=1176..1714; grid 4 at x=1935, y=790..1692). All four edge beams read B1(+0.30) at 5x zoom. Two side beams (C3-D3, C4-D4) were missing from the earlier extraction entirely and have been added; the south beam moved from '~C1 to ~C2 south' to D3-D4 span 3.00, and confidences were raised from 0.45 accordingly.

'RB1'' (a distinct printed beam mark, not a dummy-grid-prime notation — confirmed by its own rebar section on หน้า20) appears 3 times on this sheet: once near the stairwell void's NW corner (~A2, level +0.40) and twice at the south room's bottom corners, which are now resolved to the named grids D3 and D4 (level +0.30 each) rather than the old '~C1/~C2 south' approximations. Kept as 3 separate atomic entries (span/beam element, never merged) per §4.

Slab-direction arrows with a level figure (e.g. '+0.45', '+0.50') appear throughout the interior bays — these mark precast-plank laying direction/slab top level within each bay, not distinct elements, and were not individually extracted (same treatment as the precedent house 28บ้าน_เล็ก_2ชั้น_12 used for its slab-direction arrows).
